answer: Accounts traced to one funding source can share a single reward pool, an oasis whose zenith stays fixed at 100 POA per round however many accounts drink. With 1,000 fakes each earns 0.1 while a 1 POA stake apiece still applies, so 1,000 POA is locked to chase the same 100. A comet pattern, a burst of wallets seeded from one address, flags the cluster; proven laundering forfeits all its stakes. Colluders cannot split costs, because pooling funds merges their lineages and shrinks every share. Honest agents with one wallet keep the full cap at no extra effort.
